title: Catching a free hour together
meaning: Pleasure can arrive through small turns in the day, while withdrawal may make it harder to share the moment together.
text: Not every good moment of rest is scheduled in advance. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Svadhisthana allows leisure to change with circumstances: noticing a free hour, stepping somewhere unplanned or accepting an unexpected suggestion. The Hermit in energy tends towards withdrawal here, a wish to retreat into private quiet before discovering each other's wishes. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions describes the response to change: a pleasant turn brings delight, while enjoyment can feel inconsistently available. Acting with change and experiencing it have different roles.

For example, walking home you notice a small exhibition that is open. You could step inside briefly, but each assumes the other only wants to get home. **An unexpected pleasure becomes shared when there is time to mention it.** The opportunity passes without either refusal or agreement. A brief suggestion would have left you a choice: share an impression now or freely prefer another rest, knowing both people's actual wishes.

The difficulty is treating shifting circumstances as the sole reason for missed pleasure. It seems the right moment never arrived, although no invitation was voiced. Turning inward preserves quiet but makes shared enjoyment depend on a lucky coincidence. Naming a small possibility allows your leisure to depend on active interest in each other as well.
